Warm up time should be less than 15 minutes. b. -Text message should appear in the text display if there is any alar m. 67. The ma ttress shall be waterproof, easily washable, and equipped with a cover made of fire-retardant material. 68. Bassinet should have an integrated weighting scale with a capacity to weight from 400gm to 7000gm with accuracy of +-5 gm. 69.
